title: The Best Recipe
author: Casper Dravenmoor
blurb: Edmund Galloway, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must expose what the school board buried before prom.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
